purpose: What each score deficiency means and what work would remove it, written from the rubric definitions (docs/brains/scoring/*-score-v1.json, SCORING.md, brains/wind/research/tools/sector_wind_research/scoreboard.py) and the research gap registers (brains/*/research/GAPS.json). Never an input to any score. An entry describes the rubric rule and the work; it never states a measured value (those come from the evaluation being explained) and never promises a score.

nature.PREDICTION_QUALITY: changes how well the Brain predicts or measures the world
nature.KNOWLEDGE: changes what the Brain knows (research content)
nature.EVIDENCE_PROCESS: changes how far existing knowledge is reviewed/validated; can move the score without changing predictions
nature.COVERAGE: extends the same capability to more lakes / species
nature.INTEGRATION: connects or publishes a capability other Brains or customers consume
nature.DEPLOYMENT: puts an already-certified candidate into production

wind.rubricSource: brains/wind/research/tools/sector_wind_research/scoreboard.py (frozen rubric v1 + field scoring addendum v1)

dimension:Wind speed.title: Detect strong (>= 15 mph) night wind events
dimension:Wind speed.action: Rubric dimension 1 credit is the MINIMUM of three conditions: night pooled MAE (1.6 -> 1.0 m/s, linear), |bias| <= 0.3 m/s (pass/fail), and >= 15 mph night events detected with POD >= 0.5 and FAR <= 0.5 (pass/fail). The event condition is pass/fail, so the dimension earns nothing until high-wind detection passes, however good the MAE is. Work: calibrate the candidate's strong-wind behaviour, then re-score on the next completed evidence window.

blocker.detail: Dimensions 1-4 are scored on the frozen evidence window until the H2 holdout unseals; live skill cannot be credited before then.

dimension:Gust.title: Detect >= 20 kt gusts
dimension:Gust.action: Rubric dimension 3 credit is the MINIMUM of: |conditional gust bias| (3 -> 1 m/s, linear) and >= 20 kt gust detection with POD >= 0.6 and FAR <= 0.6 (pass/fail). Work: reduce gust under-forecast bias and improve strong-gust detection, then re-score on the next completed evidence window.

blocker.detail: Scored on the frozen evidence window until the H2 holdout unseals.

dimension:Direction.title: Tighten wind direction accuracy
dimension:Direction.action: Rubric dimension 2 credit is the MINIMUM of: share of hours within 22.5 degrees (0.65 -> 0.85, linear) and circular MAE <= 20 degrees (pass/fail). Full credit needs >= 85 % of hours within 22.5 degrees.

dimension:Lead time.title: Hold forecast skill at longer lead times
dimension:Lead time.action: Rubric dimension 4: +18 h MAE degradation versus +1 h (50 % -> 15 %, linear) and beating persistence at every lead >= +3 h (pass/fail).

dimension:Fetch method.title: Keep the fetch method certified
dimension:Fetch method.action: Rubric dimension 5 is pass/fail on the SPM84/CEM 9-ray method, independent exact-geometry median difference <= 5 %, the six frozen cases and resolution flags.

dimension:Exposure (field).title: Field-validate bank exposure (holdout certification)
dimension:Exposure (field).action: Only the one-time HOLDOUT certification counts (practice and calibration never do). Field scoring addendum v1 credit is the MINIMUM of: exposure concordance (0.50 -> 0.80), bank pairs / 40, lakes / 2 and direction quadrants / 3. Work: collect real bank-pair exposure observations on at least two lakes across three wind quadrants, then run the certification.

blocker.detail: No field observations exist yet; the evidence must be collected on the water.

dimension:Surface (field).title: Field-validate surface (chop) prediction (holdout certification)
dimension:Surface (field).action: Only the one-time HOLDOUT certification counts. Addendum v1 credit is the MINIMUM of: exact class match (0.20 -> 0.60), within one class (0.50 -> 0.90), severe misses (0.25 -> 0.05) and observations / 60. Work: collect at least 60 real surface-condition observations, then run the certification.

blocker.detail: No field observations exist yet; the evidence must be collected on the water.

dimension:Freshness-reliability.title: Accrue 30 valid live archive days
dimension:Freshness-reliability.action: Rubric dimension 8 counts only the live shadow: credit is the MINIMUM of 30-day completeness (days / 30 x worst source share / 0.99), median NBM availability age <= 90 min and fallbacks exercised. It grows by itself with every complete, valid UTC day; the work is keeping the hourly archive complete.

blocker.detail: Accrues one valid UTC day at a time.

dimension:Coverage.title: Keep lake coverage passing QA
dimension:Coverage.action: Rubric dimension 9: development lakes complete (1 -> 4) and directory lakes passing national QA (0 -> 50), credit is the minimum.

dimension:Provenance-Unknown.title: Keep provenance and Unknown handling complete
dimension:Provenance-Unknown.action: Rubric dimension 10 is pass/fail on kind everywhere, Unknown shown grey and an explanation on every result.

gate:fieldValidation@6.title: Lift the 6.0 field-validation cap
gate:fieldValidation@6.action: The certification caps the score at 6.0 while BOTH exposure and surface have zero field credit. Any certified field credit on either dimension lifts this cap.

blocker.detail: Needs real field observations (bank pairs or surface observations).

gate:fieldValidation@7.title: Add an over-water wind reference
gate:fieldValidation@7.action: The certification caps the score at 7.0 until wind validation includes measured over-water station comparisons (today it is land-only).

blocker.detail: Needs an over-water reference station (buoy or on-lake anemometer) with measured comparisons.
H2 holdout sealed; no live skill is scored before it unseals.

labels.registryCompleteness: Every registered species assessed or explicitly NOT_ASSESSED
labels.knowledgeDepth: Median species-v2 overallRounded over assessed species
labels.regionalTransfer: Knowledge tagged for the lake's region
labels.productionIntegration: Consumed by Intelligence or a customer path

dimension:knowledgeDepth.title: Deepen species knowledge (median species score)
dimension:knowledgeDepth.action: The dimension is the MEDIAN species-v2 overallRounded over assessed species, so it rises only when the middle of the species distribution improves. Work: species-by-species research on each species' weakest domains (see Species Intelligence open gaps), published as a validated knowledge release.

blocker.detail: New species research counts only after it is published to production as a knowledge release.

dimension:biologicalStateImpl.title: Take per-lake Biological State live
dimension:biologicalStateImpl.action: Rubric scale: NOT_STARTED 0, IN_PROGRESS 4, LIVE 8, VALIDATED 10 (responsibilities.biologicalState.status). Work: publish per-lake Biological State for the fleet.

blocker.detail: Depth and Vegetation inputs are unpublished; graduation of the pilot needs Michael's decision (FISH-PRD-001).

dimension:biologicalStateValidation.title: Validate per-lake Biological State
dimension:biologicalStateValidation.action: Rubric scale: NOT_STARTED 0, PARTIAL 5, VALIDATED 10 (responsibilities.biologicalState.validation). Work: a preregistered comparison of per-lake states against field outcomes.

blocker.detail: Needs field outcomes (FISH-VAL-001) and a live per-lake state to validate.

dimension:evidenceQuality.title: Independent review, then field validation, of assessed species
dimension:evidenceQuality.action: Rubric scale: VALIDATED share x 10, else REVIEWED share x 7, else RESEARCH present -> 2. Work: independent review of assessed species (REVIEWED), then field validation (VALIDATED).

blocker.detail: The runtime refuses REVIEWED / VALIDATED until a separate promotion decision (FISH-EVI-001).

dimension:contradictionsGaps.title: Resolve open species contradictions
dimension:contradictionsGaps.action: Rubric scale: 10 x (1 - mean over assessed species of min(contradictionCount, 5) / 5). Work: resolve the open discrepancies listed per species, published as a knowledge release.

blocker.detail: Counts only after the resolving release is published.

dimension:assessedCoverage.title: Assess the remaining eligible species
dimension:assessedCoverage.action: Rubric scale: assessed / registered species x 10. Species marked NOT_ASSESSED by Fish Brain policy are intentionally excluded; assessing them is a product decision, not a research gap.

blocker.detail: Remaining species are NOT_ASSESSED by policy (see each species' policy note).

dimension:regionalTransfer.title: Publish region-tagged species knowledge
dimension:regionalTransfer.action: The rubric marks this dimension UNKNOWN until the Fish Brain publishes knowledge tagged for the lake's region; it contributes nothing while unknown.

dimension:registryCompleteness.title: Keep every registered species assessed or explicitly NOT_ASSESSED
dimension:registryCompleteness.action: Rubric scale: 10 when assessed + not assessed == registered species, else 0.

dimension:productionIntegration.title: Stay consumed by Sector Intelligence
dimension:productionIntegration.action: Rubric scale: 10 when Sector Intelligence's biological-state dependency is CONNECTED / CONNECTED_DEGRADED, else 0.

gate:speciesValidation.title: Validate the first species (lifts the 6.0 cap)
gate:speciesValidation.action: The score is capped at 6.0 while no species is at researchMaturity VALIDATED. Work: independent review, then field validation, of at least one species.

blocker.detail: VALIDATED is refused by the runtime until a promotion decision; field validation is required first.

gate:biologicalState.title: Start per-lake Biological State (lifts the 4.0 cap)
gate:biologicalState.action: The score is capped at 4.0 while per-lake Biological State is NOT_STARTED.

water-clarity.rubricSource: docs/brains/scoring/frozen-scores.json (FROZEN research certification; the production models carry no score)

gate:deployment.title: Approve and deploy the certified R3.1 candidate, then re-certify on live data
gate:deployment.action: The published 8.0 is the frozen research certification of candidate R3.1 (NOT_DEPLOYED). Production clarity is served by models that carry no score. A production score exists only after R3.1 is approved, deployed and re-certified on live data.

blocker.detail: Promotion needs Michael's explicit approval, then a production deployment through the Publisher cutover (Water Clarity is SHADOW).

gate:level4ProtectedTruth.title: Collect protected truth for the Level-4 comparison
gate:level4ProtectedTruth.action: The Level-4 gate failed on protected-truth sufficiency (two protected lakes below the 25-cast minimum), not on model error. Work: TVA forebay profiles or Sector loggers for those lakes, then the Level-4 comparison.

blocker.detail: Needs protected temperature truth that does not exist yet.

labels.sourceAuthority: Level source is the operator pool or the lake's own gauge
labels.trendQuality: Last state is observed, not a proxy

gate:coverage.title: Profile at least 10 % of directory lakes (lifts the 3.0 cap)
gate:coverage.action: The score is capped at 3.0 while fewer than 10 % of directory lakes are profiled. Work: reviewed source bindings for more lakes.

gate:validation.title: Run a validation against operator truth (lifts the 5.0 cap)
gate:validation.action: The score is capped at 5.0 while /validation/lake-brain is NOT_VALIDATED.

gate:health.title: Restore Lake Brain health (lifts the 2.0 cap)
gate:health.action: The score is capped at 2.0 while brain health is FAILED or UNKNOWN.

dimension:coverage.title: Profile more directory lakes
dimension:coverage.action: Coverage ladder over profiled / directory lakes: > 0 -> 1, >= 5 % -> 2, 10 % -> 3, 25 % -> 5, 50 % -> 7, 75 % -> 9, 90 % -> 10.

dimension:validation.title: Validate lake levels against operator truth

dimension:floodDroughtContext.title: Publish flood-pool state for more lakes
dimension:floodDroughtContext.action: Share of lake states with a known flood-pool state x 10.

labels.dependencyHandling: Every upstream Brain has a published dependency status
labels.synthesisQuality: Drivers / limiting factors present and consistent

gate:validation.title: Validate Sector Intelligence (lifts the 5.0 cap)
gate:validation.action: The score is capped at 5.0 while /validation/sector-intelligence is NOT_VALIDATED.

dimension:normalizedEvaluations.title: Evaluate more lakes
dimension:normalizedEvaluations.action: Lakes with a normalized evaluation / directory lakes, on the coverage ladder (10 % -> 3, 25 % -> 5, 50 % -> 7, 90 % -> 10).

dimension:lakeCoverage.title: Support more lakes
dimension:lakeCoverage.action: supportedLakeCount / directory lakes, on the coverage ladder.

dimension:synthesisQuality.title: Make synthesis quality measurable
dimension:synthesisQuality.action: The rubric marks this dimension UNKNOWN until evaluations exist to measure drivers / limiting factors; it contributes nothing while unknown.
